allowed: reasoning trace when the target exposes it

architecture: frozen QueRE-style active-probe classifier over 16 published model-behavior questions
legacy lexical and n-gram development baselines
nonnegative logistic fusion calibrated on evaluator-only labels
hard structured CapabilityGuard outside the statistical monitor

active_probe_boundary.trusted_transport: Replays original system, user question, and visible answer to the same target for follow-up queries.
active_probe_boundary.runtime_classifier_input: Opaque request ID, frozen question-set hash, and 16 YES probabilities only.
active_probe_boundary.latency: Offline or hold-before-release active audit; not continuous dynamic monitoring.

evaluation.split: leave-one-behavior-family-out development followed by a sealed unseen-family evaluation
evaluation.public_organisms: development-only because their ground truth is searchable

claim_boundary: The 60-row public panel and factual-corruption matched pairs are development evidence. The final claim is limited to one frozen, precommitted unseen-family code-sabotage test with matched same-base controls and five seeds; it is not an undisclosed third-party organism or universal-defense claim.
